justifications.scope_discipline: the diff from 4542d2c33 to 3de3a0d6c touches only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, tests/test_plan_review_prefix_is_one_constant.py and docs/evidence/fragments/new-work-gets-a-new-worker/a-review-run-has-one-predicate.html, all inside the declared write paths.
